title: AI Content Calendar
summary: Generate a monthly content calendar with post ideas, captions, and hashtags based on your business, reviews, and seasonal events.
businessProblem: Social media posting is inconsistent because content ideas run dry. Owners post reactively or go silent for weeks, hurting engagement and local visibility.
outcome: A 4-week content calendar with 12–16 post ideas, draft captions in your brand voice, suggested posting days, and hashtag sets — ready for scheduling.
whoItsFor: SMBs doing their own social media without a dedicated marketer — especially local businesses that need consistent Google and social presence.
aiInputs: Business description, services, and target customer
Recent positive review quotes for social proof posts
Seasonal events and local holidays for the month
Brand voice guide and past top-performing posts
aiOutputs: 4-week calendar grid with post type per day
Draft caption per post (short and long versions)
Content type mix: promotional, educational, social proof, behind-the-scenes
noCodeTools: ChatGPT or Claude monthly content planning session
Buffer or Hootsuite AI caption tools
lowCodeTools: n8n: monthly trigger → pull reviews → OpenAI calendar → Google Sheet
Jasper or Copy.ai with brand voice profile
customBuildStack: Review data pull from Google Business Profile API
Output to Notion database or Airtable content calendar
implementationSteps: Document brand voice: tone, words to use/avoid, emoji policy
List services, promotions, and events for the upcoming month
Pull 10 recent positive reviews for social proof content
Generate calendar with AI using structured output template
Review and adjust — replace any generic or off-brand ideas
Schedule approved posts in Buffer, Later, or native platform schedulers
systemBehavior: Runs monthly (or on-demand for campaign planning)
Generates ideas and drafts — does not auto-post
Balances content types to avoid all-promotional calendars
Incorporates real customer language from reviews
Flags posts that need photos the business doesn't have yet
risks: Generic AI captions sound identical to competitors using the same tools
Seasonal references may be wrong if AI lacks current date context
Social proof posts using review quotes need customer permission on some platforms
Hashtag suggestions may include irrelevant or banned tags
